title: Make three slow functions fast
goal: Make lis_length, count_inversions and top_k_frequent faster on large inputs. Deliver one complete Python 3 algos.py. The hidden grader scores speed only if correctness passes. bench.py and test_algos.py are available.
rubric: Preserve the original behavior on edge cases, including tie-breaking, negatives, duplicates and floats. LIS and inversion counting must preserve the original behavior on NaN inputs.
